parameters.content:
## Live Dick Capital intake — REVIEW ONLY
Every 5 minutes, Gmail checks the verified project account for Dick Capital chat-thread notifications. Sender, List-Id, Gmail authentication results, subject suffix, author marker, and MIME structure are validated before extraction.

New messages are durably checkpointed and deduplicated in Processing Log, then sent to Analyzer B. All real results remain human-review-only: Position Manager C is never called automatically and Current Positions are never changed by this branch.

NO_TRADE stops quietly. Trade candidates and uncertainties create private Discord review alerts without quoting newsletter text. Sheet writes are read back before notification. Historical October messages are duplicate no-ops.

The original 59-check fictional Level 3 harness remains intact.
